name: Sporthotel Austria
beschreibung:
Overview

Sporthotel Austria is a family-run 4-star hotel in St. Johann in Tirol, located on the outskirts of the village in a quiet yet central position. Owner Johnny Theilersgaard and his team welcome guests in a house with 43 rooms spread over three floors, all easily accessible by lift. The hotel is nestled in the wide valley between the Wilder Kaiser and the Kitzbüheler Horn, combining an urban ambience with an alpine nature experience.

Facilities include an indoor pool (7 x 13 m), a small wellness area with sauna, steam bath and infrared cabin, and a fitness room. A cosy hotel lobby with an open fireplace and a bar area with a fireplace lounge invite guests to linger. In summer, a spacious garden is available to guests. The house is run as a family-friendly hotel, and pets are welcome.

History/Background

As stated in the imprint of the official website, the business is run as Sporthotel Austria KG under the management of owner Johnny Theilersgaard. The house presents itself as a 4-star sports hotel and combines a family atmosphere with a sporting focus. It is just a few minutes' walk from the village centre and from the St. Johann mountain lift (Skistar St. Johann in Tirol). No founding date is recorded in the official sources and is therefore not mentioned here.

Getting there

The address is Winterstellerweg 3, 6380 St. Johann in Tirol. According to the tourism region, the hotel is around 0.2 km from the ski area, 0.4 km from the village centre and about 0.9 km from the nearest bus stop and the cross-country ski trail. The centre, shops, cafés and the mountain lift are within a few minutes' walk. For drivers, a car park and a garage are available; according to the region, there is also a ski storage room and a charging station for electric cars. Check-in is from 3.00 p.m., check-out until 10.00 a.m. The St. Johann Card, available from the hosts, includes the regional bus and train connections.

Tips

In the wellness area with indoor pool (7 x 13 m), sauna, steam bath and infrared cabin, as well as in the fitness room, you can relax after a day in the mountains. In summer, the garden invites you to relax, and once a week a barbecue evening is offered. Culinary-wise, the kitchen spoils guests with a rich breakfast buffet (sparkling wine breakfast on Sundays) and, in the evening, a 4-course menu in summer and a 5-course menu in winter; the gala evening is also part of the programme. Practical for active holidaymakers are the e-bike charging station and the ski storage room.

Best time to travel

St. Johann in Tirol and the Kitzbühel Alps are a year-round destination. Winter is suitable for skiing and snowboarding as well as ski and snowshoe tours, summer for hiking, biking and golf. The hotel is in the immediate vicinity of the mountain lift and the hiking area, so both seasons are suitable for an active holiday.
